title: Cloud Control authority and ooRexx console boundary
summary: Alchemy Cloud Control remains authority for cloud RESOURCE/NODE mutation. Cloud Console dev4 is the qualified human/code/Codex facade; provider-native reads remain separately attributable observation evidence.
invariants: ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL is the cloud RESOURCE/NODE authority already registered by Development Floor; Management does not replace it.
ooRexx Cloud Console owns interaction vocabulary, plan/apply fencing, normalized rendering and workspace-safe argument transport; it is not cloud capability truth.
cloudctl.sh remains a convenience/provider-adapter shortcut and is not the semantic API exposed to Management.
Management discovers the current cloud specialist and composes it with other specialists; it does not dispatch az, gcloud, aws, oci or Vultr syntax directly.
Provider resource handles remain action locators and must not be synthesized into Job-to-Node Allocator nodeId values.
Provider credentials and IAM remain provider authority; changing --workspace or source directory never grants mutation authority.
oorexx_cloud_console_v0.1-dev4 is qualified under exact ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and delegates mutation through alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 when configured.
Alchemy Cloud Control v0.1-dev4 supplies normalized machine list/create/start/stop/reboot/destroy and firewall list/allow/revoke/reconcile across Azure, GCP, AWS, OCI and Vultr.
Firewall reconcile replaces only the desired source CIDR set for one scoped ingress protocol/port rule, preserves unrelated rules, and rejects an empty desired set.
XTP/network/service authorities own peer or listener topology; Cloud Control executes only the bounded source-set mutation supplied by that authority.
Cloud Console provider-native read paths are observations; mutation authority does not arise from the ability to observe a provider.
No live cloud mutation, DNS/certificate change, host reconfiguration or website/mail/LDAP/HTTPS installation is implied by dev4 fixture qualification.
procedure: Resolve the authoritative cloud specialist for the fresh management request.
Present the operation through Cloud Console when a human, ooRexx program or Codex caller needs the common vocabulary.
Obtain the console plan and preserve exact provider/account/resource identity.
Apply only through the normal confirmation/policy path and delegate approved mutation to Cloud Control.
For source-set reconciliation, obtain the desired sources from the owning network/service policy; never infer them from provider inventory.
Retain provider command/output as adapter evidence rather than Management semantics.

provenance.claim: Qualified provider-neutral ooRexx human/code/Codex console with plan/apply fencing, workspace-safe argv transport, normalized machine/firewall records and five fake-provider adapters under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196; no live-cloud mutation qualification.
Development Floor pins alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 and registers ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL as RESOURCE/NODE authority.

Later Library operator helper demonstrates multi-peer firewall source reconciliation for XTP commissioning; retained as a generic firewall-reconciliation continuation requirement, not as Management semantics.

Normalized five-provider RESOURCE transport candidate; offline shell/fake-provider qualification passes machine and firewall operations, GCP account fail-closed handling, secret rejection, and OCI reboot repair. Live mutation not qualified.
Implements selectable Cloud Control mutation backend and read/mutation provenance fields; ooRexx r13196 rerun remains pending, so dev2 stays the accepted console baseline.
Fresh-extraction five-provider RESOURCE qualification passes, including scoped source-set reconciliation and fail-closed empty-set handling.
Fresh-extraction r13196 qualification passes, including real Console-to-Cloud-Control-to-provider-fixture integration and JSON round-trip regression.
Exact runtime used for dev4 console compile/execution qualification.
